Punjab government seeks UAE investment in investor outreach

Punjab's Chief Minister Majhi and Industries Minister Arora are undertaking an investment outreach in the UAE. Minister Arora met with Abdulla Ahmed Al Suwaidi, Secretary General of the UAE International Investment Council (UAEIIC), to discuss Punjab's economic potential. Arora pitched Punjab as a prime investment destination for UAE capital, highlighting opportunities in high-growth sectors through various partnership models. The outreach aims to attract UAE investors to the state's ecosystem.
